scope: Current source: distinguish a verified soft-deleted workspace from real conversation handoff and recovery failures. Preserve completed runs, queued-message deletion guards, restore behavior, KeyError compatibility and continuation of healthy conversations. No packaging or release.

baseline.reason: Five normal workspace-deletion handoff cases logged errors; two real recovery faults were silently ignored.

deterministic_checks: A real worker saves SUCCEEDED and releases its lease; a barrier pauses handoff until the workspace is legally deleted. Releasing the callback produces no error and leaves the persisted result unchanged.
A deletion between conversation lookup and workspace selection is treated as a completed wakeup.
An accepted unmaterialized reply prevents deletion and is created exactly once after repeated handoffs.
A cancelled queued reply remains cancelled and never acquires a run after deletion.
Restoring the same workspace allows a new reply on the original history.
A recovery selection that races with cancellation and deletion retires quietly.
Missing workspaces, ordinary KeyErrors with identical text, foreign-scope WorkspaceDeleted exceptions and parent-workflow failures still produce diagnostics.
A faulty conversation in a recovery batch does not prevent another real offline turn from completing.
Deleted lookups and transaction guards preserve KeyError inheritance and original args; other-tenant and missing rows do not disclose deletion state.
constraints: No deletion precondition was relaxed and no new durable callback queue was introduced.
The new classification applies to completion handoff and periodic conversation recovery; other recovery subsystems retain their existing error handling.
Fixtures use temporary databases and offline model responses; no real external model or business service is called.
Existing browser suites include historical layout coverage; no new interface or mobile scope was introduced.
The prior 793-test alert-inbox log remains a historical record of its observed background error; this record documents the later fix.
Source changes are not packaged or published.
